_README: Configuration for Heterogeneous Agent Ramsey Model
_random_seed_note: Global seed for reproducibility. Set to null to disable.

debug._anomaly_detection_note: Enable PyTorch autograd anomaly detection. Useful for debugging NaN gradients but slows training ~2-3x.

versioning._comment_1: Set input_version to load existing model (e.g., '1.0.0'), null starts fresh.
versioning._comment_2: Both ha_model_v{version}.pth and boundary_v{version}.pkl will be loaded/saved.

training._adaptive_sampling_note: Keep sampling batch_sample_size candidates until min_admissible_samples valid points are accumulated
training._lambda_comment: lambda_boundary: hypercube penalty (fixed), lambda_shape: alpha-shape projection penalty (fixed), lambda_fb: adaptive (see fischer_burmeister section)
training._checkpoint_frequency_note: Save checkpoint every N iterations. Set to 0 to disable.

boundary._min_boundary_samples_note: Target number of valid points to collect for α-shape boundary update
boundary._sampling_method_note: uniform=full hypercube, expanded_shape=α-shape expanded from centroid, gaussian=admissible points + noise
boundary._expansion_percent_note: For expanded_shape: how much to expand outward (0.20=20%). For gaussian: σ = expansion_percent × range
